result.instructions: Research only; scalar data inputs, existing counted proof APIs, no network. No release/native assurance is implied.

tools.name: prove
tools.description: Check scalar natural rule laws with existing kernel proofs; only checked proofs are proven.

tools.name: why_not
tools.description: Find an existing interpreter-checked shortest counterexample within explicit finite depth/value bounds.

tools.name: suggest
tools.description: Call inferLaws and check supplied near-miss candidates; return pasteable source and real bounded counterexamples.

tools.name: check_change
tools.description: Compare two revisions against the same laws and existing compose refinement; distinguish lost proof from a real counterexample.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Read evidence observed by this process for an exact unit/revision; never trust a caller-supplied label.
